# About

Imad EL BADISY is a research engineer in biostatistics working at the interface of computational biostatistics and machine learning for health research.

His work focuses on survival analysis, missing data, interpretable machine learning, reproducible R packages, and applied health data science training.

For a full overview of research, software, teaching, and publications, visit the [homepage](index.qmd).
